binding_integrity.all_declared_designs_resolved: every declared design (128 Sobol + 96 sweep-v2) built / rebuilt, solved on both maps and characterized (no exclusions)
binding_integrity.determinism_replay: re-solving and re-characterizing the replay designs in the main process reproduces the worker's canonical topology/descriptor payload bytes exactly and the accepted psi grid node-for-node
binding_integrity.every_null_converged: definition v3: every axis null in every map converged, X-type, classifications agree
binding_integrity.every_trace_terminates_cleanly: definition v3: every separatrix terminates as wall or domain_z
binding_integrity.every_wall_trace_flux_consistent: definition v3: every wall-reaching trace agrees with the flux root within 5e-5 m
binding_integrity.hash_bindings: protocol, experiment code, dependency sources, field pipeline sources and sealed-source identities equal the preregistered authorities
binding_integrity.held_out_sweep_v2_reproduction: for every sweep-v2 design: rebuilt hashes equal the sealed record, the re-solved QoIs replay within the sweep-v2 scale-aware tolerances, the four stored representatives reproduce node-wise, and the sealed axis nulls inside the v3 window are in bijection with the v3 nulls within 0.25 mm
binding_integrity.identity_proven: every design's geometry / source / config / case hashes equal the frozen design authorities; sweep-v2 designs additionally equal the sealed raw record
binding_integrity.refinement_stability: catalogue stability: same axis-null count, same wall-reaching count, |dz_k| and |dz_c| <= 0.25 mm between the accepted and the 2x refined map for every design
binding_integrity.solver_converged_both_maps: the accepted and the refined CPU solves report converged = true
binding_integrity.sweep_v2_gates_verbatim: every design passes the six sweep-v2 metric gates with their recorded definitions: boundary_to_peak_ratio <= 0.05, relative_residual_l2 <= 1e-10, flux_reconstruction_identity_t_per_m <= 1e-8, source_representation_error <= 0.25, topology_confidence >= 0.5, min(radial, axial manufacturing margin) >= 0; the seventh sweep-v2 gate (cpu_cuda_parity) has no CUDA solve to compare in this CPU-only campaign and is replaced by determinism_replay

hash_bindings_note: verified against the frozen authorities in the prebundle
